body.value:
The notebook stayed beside the door. We recorded the plants that survived, the tools that needed repair, and the names of neighbors who offered to help.

A record is useful when another person can read it, carry it away, and add something of their own.

我们把手记放在门边，记下存活的植物、需要修理的工具，还有愿意帮忙的邻居。

一份记录的价值，在于别人能够读懂、带走，并添上自己的发现。
